description: One match in detail: score, status, goals, cards and substitutions with minutes, line-ups, team statistics (possession, shots, corners…), injuries, form, standings of both teams, match report and head-to-head record.

format.description: text (default): compact summary with IDs and links. json: the raw data feed, minified and capped at 60,000 characters

h2h.description: Include the head-to-head record. Default: true

id.description: Match ID (from fixtures, live scores or search)

language.description: Language for team, competition and country names, and for the football-mania.com links (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, pt-BR, nl, ar, ru, tr, id, …). Default: en

timezone.description: IANA time zone for kick-off times and dates, e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Riyadh. Default: UTC

name: get_match
